notice: Approved project templates. Every file's sha256 is verified before bytes enter CAS; unlisted templates are not loadable.

templates.description: Minimal article draft: amsmath/booktabs/hyperref, BibTeX bibliography, placeholder abstract and introduction.
Minimal report draft: report class with TOC, graphicx, BibTeX bibliography.

Chinese article (中文文章): ctexart with Fandol fonts; amsthm environments named 定理/引理/定义/证明, booktabs, graphicx, hyperref; sections 摘要+关键词/引言/相关工作/方法/实验与结果/结论; BibTeX bibliography in GB/T 7714-2015 numeric style (gbt7714).

Chinese thesis or long report skeleton (中文学位论文/长篇报告): ctexbook with Fandol fonts; cover page, 中文摘要 + English abstract, 目录, chapters 绪论/相关工作/方法/实验/结论, 附录, 致谢; theorem environments; BibTeX in GB/T 7714-2015 numeric style (gbt7714). Generic, not any university's official format.

English slide deck: beamer 16:9 (Boadilla theme) with title frame, outline, motivation, a frame with a numbered equation, a booktabs results table, take-home messages and a closing frame; no bibliography.
Chinese slide deck (中文演示文稿): ctexbeamer 16:9 with Fandol fonts (Boadilla theme); 标题页, 目录, 研究背景, a frame with a numbered equation, a booktabs results table, 总结 and a closing frame; no bibliography.

English one-page cover letter (standard letter class): sender and recipient address blocks, date, opening, three guided body paragraphs, closing and enclosure line; for job/fellowship applications or a manuscript-submission letter to a journal editor.

Chinese exam or worksheet, student version (试卷/练习卷学生版): exam class + ctex with Fandol fonts; marks written only as \question[N]/\part[N], total declared once in \fullmarks (verified by score-sum), grade table, choice and multi-part questions; no answers in source (\printanswers stays commented; answers belong in a separate exam-teacher target). English questions work too.
